results.text: An SGLT2 inhibitor, canagliflozin, reduces blood glucose level in the renal capillaries and protects the capillary network in the diabetic rats. Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors consistently demonstrate renal protection against progressive kidney disease. We hypothesised that SGLT2 inhibition reduces blood glucose levels in peri-proximal tubular capillaries by limiting reabsorption from the tubular filtrate, thereby safeguarding the renal microvasculature from hyperglycaemic stress.
